scripts.generate-blog: node scripts/generateBlog.mjs && prettier --write public/content/blog-index.json public/feed-*.xml public/blog/**/index.html && eslint --no-ignore public/content/blog-index.json
scripts.generate-sitemaps: node scripts/generateSitemaps.mjs && prettier --write public/sitemap.xml public/llms.txt public/robots.txt
scripts.dev: npm run generate-blog && npm run generate-sitemaps && npm run test && vite
scripts.build: npm run generate-blog && npm run generate-sitemaps && npm run lint && npm run test && vite build
